items.titulo: Meet Meta’s JiTTests: LLM-Generated Tests Designed to Fail Before Risky Code Lands
items.resumen: Meta has moved Catching JiTTests into production. The LLM system writes tests designed to fail on risky diffs, and caught 74 privacy SEVs before landing in H1 2026, with a 60% engineer-reported true-positive rate. The post Meet Meta’s JiTTests: LLM-Generated Tests Designed to Fail Before Risky Code Lands appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context
items.resumen: Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, a proprietary 2.4T-parameter MoE model with 71B active parameters, native vision and a 1M-token context. items.titulo: Hark Releases Handoff², a 2x Faster Computer-Use Agent for Hark Pro
items.resumen: Hark has released Handoff², the computer-use agent inside Hark Pro. It averages 2x faster than v1, completes 82% of 478 internal web tasks, and learned to batch actions through latency-penalized RL.
